title: Choose the workspace structure
question: Three structures for the executive workspace, same JusDesk world (Inter, purple, light). Lock one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Inbox with a case sheet
options.thesis: A fast, full-width queue; the case slides over it as a sheet, decision pinned at its foot.
options.viewport: Queue rows with stage and next step; Ananya's case open as a sheet over the right two-thirds.
options.risk: The queue can feel hidden while a case is open.

options.label: Conversation beside evidence
options.thesis: What the customer said on the left, what the facts say on the right; open cases as tabs.
options.viewport: Chat and email thread with the bot handoff on the left; evidence, facts and decision on the right.
options.risk: Closest to a familiar helpdesk; needs the evidence pane to carry it.

options.label: Decision first
options.thesis: The case opens on the choice: three resolutions side by side, each with its cost and promise.
options.viewport: Headline contradiction, then Reship + claim, Refund, and Wait 24h as three columns; evidence below.
options.risk: Can feel like the decision is made before the agent has looked.
